races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Point winner ALWAYS A REASON makes his handicap debut off a lowly mark and earns the vote ahead of Red Cadillac.

comments.alwaysareason: Irish point winner who is open to improvement now moving into handicaps; watch the betting
comments.benito: He's failed to threaten on his two starts this year following a long absence
comments.blakeyboy: Could be back on better ground for this handicap debut and he's a possible improver
comments.cagerattler: Third at 100-1 on recent handicap hurdle debut at Newcastle; chance if backing that up
comments.finaledgar: Just 1-15 but went close at Catterick in January and could be involved
comments.knomorediamonds: Sixth at Musselburgh last time but in a stronger race than this; possible player
comments.lesslegacy: His form has deteriorated but he was a fair fourth last time and is another 2lb lower here
comments.nobleaffair: C&D winner; best run for a while when fourth at Ayr last month but needs something extra
comments.redcadillac: Placed in both handicaps and this could be a good opportunity to get off the mark
comments.romeobrown: Regressive 11yo who has failed to threaten this season; hopes pinned on wind operation
comments.shadowsinthesky: Two chase wins here last year but has struggled in that sphere on his last three starts

races.raceComment: shadowsinthesky is marginally preferred with a score of 54.7%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over nobleaffair. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: This looks a good opportunity for Fergal O'Brien's ZUCAYAN (nap) to build on his promising Ludlow third and resume winning ways

comments.begintheluck: In good nick over fences, third at Warwick in December; much respected back in this sphere
comments.bigzbelief: Solid third in 1m7f Wincanton handicap 19 days ago; on a long losing run but shortlisted
comments.brucegobbler: Below-par seventh for his new yard in 2m3f handicap here in January; plenty more required
comments.forcedefrap: C&D winner but pulled up on his last two starts, latest in 2m4f Bangor handicap hurdle
comments.janespriceless: Very lightly raced hurdler has yet to offer much; she's hard to make a case for
comments.jimdesarti: Runner-up at Sedgefield before unseated rider early at Huntingdon; can't be discounted
comments.johnbetjeman: Back to form when second at Wincanton 19 days ago; up 3lb but he ought to be thereabouts
comments.mrzee: In good form, third here last month; he's well in the mix off the same mark
comments.opticality: Beat only one when last seen in this sphere at Fontwell last April; has a bit to prove
comments.patemollee: Pulled up on yard debut at Wetherby last month; needs to take step forward now h'capping
comments.princerhinegold: Winless since early 2023 and tenth at Wincanton on Boxing Day; easy to look elsewhere
comments.taritino: Back on track with a C&D fifth 15 days ago; very much one to consider off a 2lb lower mark
comments.usandthem: Winless since 2018 and pulled up in 2m3f Warwick handicap hurdle last month
comments.zucayan: Caught the eye when third at Ludlow latest, set plenty to do; form franked so a big shout

races.raceComment: begintheluck is marginally preferred with a score of 62.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over zucayan. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 6 wins from 44 starts in similar conditions, though returning from absence and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Kipp Kelly has had no luck lately but it's hard to get away from recent well-backed winner MIDNIGHTATTHEOASIS (nap).

comments.cuan: Hasn't offered much in two handicaps this time round; dips below 6f for the first time
comments.dashgordon: First poor effort for this yard when well held over C&D latest; needs to bounce back
comments.heneryhawk: Three-time C&D winner who's regressed in recent times; much will hinge on how he gets away
comments.kippkelly: Will again need the breaks from an outside stall but is surely up to winning off this mark
comments.mewshouse: More expected back with his old yard here last month; is capable of better
comments.midnightattheoasis: Very well backed when winning off a 5lb lower mark for Rossa Ryan 11 days ago; shortlisted
comments.phoenixstar: Five-time C&D winner who's on the downgrade but handicapped accordingly; each-way shout
comments.popdancer: Regressed in recent times but arrives in form and this is his first crack at 0-55 company
comments.rockleypoint: Placed a couple of times here at big prices lately but is some way down the pecking order
comments.sirbenedict: Isn't as good or consistent as he used to be but has claims if repeating his latest effort
comments.sixcor: Solid comeback but lacks consistency and there's little wiggle room off this mark
comments.stallone: Won this last year off 9lb higher and rarely runs poorly over C&D but is on the downgrade

races.raceComment: dashgordon is marginally preferred with a score of 53.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over heneryhawk. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.bombsquad: Multiple wins on Tapeta elsewhere; acts here too; remained in form since February 7f win
comments.clochnua: Three classified wins at 1m and 7f; impressive in 1m handicap here latest; back up 4lb
comments.rooska: Maiden; had two layoffs since late 2023 and run only twice in that time; shade risky
comments.saisonsdor: Three C&D successes; all handicap wins off higher marks than today's; not far away
comments.starlightstanley: Faded over 1m on handicap debut last May; off since; too many unknowns on this AW debut
